name: Reservoir simulation (black oil, compositional, thermal)
principle: Numerical models solve mass conservation, phase behaviour and Darcy flow on a grid to forecast production and test recovery schemes. Black-oil models track oil, water and gas; compositional models track components with an equation of state; thermal models add energy balance for heavy oil.

process_steps.name: Build static grid and rock-fluid properties
History match to production and pressure

advantages: Tests recovery options before spending capital
limitations: Compositional runs cost more setup, compute and memory
Result quality depends on history match and geological model
